title: Hole Rush 3D
description: Dynamic 3D arcade title with tactile physics-driven hole mechanics. Devour environment elements, expand in scale, and beat procedural level challenges.
notes: v1.0 built for Android. Existing privacy policy transitioning to this official portal.

title: Arrow Puzzle
description: Deceptively intricate pathfinding puzzle requiring strategic navigation through directional arrow mazes without collision.
notes: Published to Google Play testing track; awaiting production approval.

title: Hexa Puzzle
description: Tactile hexagon-based color matching puzzle. Shift same-colored blocks to merge and clear clusters of 6-7 tiles for maximum scores before the board fills.
notes: Core build complete and ready for release distribution.

title: Block Puzzle
description: Clean, satisfying geometric puzzle inspired by classic block-clearing mechanics. Engineered for instant touch response and high spatial replayability.
notes: Polished Android build ready for deployment.

title: Shadow Descent
description: A darker, more demanding precision platformer emphasizing atmospheric silhouette art direction, environmental hazards, and unforgiving timing.
notes: Under active development with heightened gameplay challenge.
